name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana (EBC Fee Reimbursement, Maharashtra)
benefit: Reimbursement of tuition fees and examination fees for Economically Backward Class (EBC/EWS and open-category economically weaker) students of Maharashtra admitted to Diploma, Degree or Postgraduate professional and non-professional courses. Generally 50% of tuition and exam fees are reimbursed; girl students in professional courses receive 100% reimbursement of tuition and exam fees (per the expanded girls' variant). Benefit is paid in two installments directly into the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via the MahaDBT portal.
eligibility_rules: Applicant must be an Indian national and a domicile of Maharashtra State
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 8,00,000

Must be a bonafide student of the institute, admitted to a professional/non-professional or technical course (Diploma / Graduation / Post-Graduation) approved as per the relevant Government Resolutions
Admission must have been secured through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) for professional courses
Applies to General/Open (EWS) and SEBC category students in government, government-aided and unaided non-minority institutions
Renewal application required each academic year on MahaDBT with previous year's passing marksheets
Students from the Maharashtra-Karnataka border area can also apply
exclusions: Family income above Rs 8,00,000 per annum makes the student ineligible
Students admitted outside the CAP process (e.g. management quota) are not eligible for the professional-course variant
Students receiving benefits from any other scholarship or stipend for the same expenses are not eligible
Students pursuing distance-education or part-time courses are not eligible
Students with an academic gap of more than 2 years are not eligible
Maximum 2 beneficiaries per family (an undertaking to this effect is required)
Students studying outside Maharashtra are not covered
documents_required: Income certificate from Tehsildar (family income proof)
CAP admission allotment letter / admission receipt and fee receipt from the college
Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-seeded bank account details
Undertaking that not more than 2 family members are availing the benefit
how_to_apply: Apply online on the MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in): register as a new applicant, complete the profile, select the Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana, fill the form, upload documents and submit. Renewal each academic year. Helpline: 1800-120-8040. Note: related variants exist - a merit scholarship of Rs 300/month for SC students scoring 75%+ in SSC studying in classes 11-12, and department-specific versions (DTE/DHE/Agriculture).
source_document: MahaDBT scheme pages (DTE/DHE); Maharashtra GRs dated 07/10/2017, 01/03/2018, 31/03/2018, 14/01/2019, 08/07/2024
